content.text:
Here's how I went through it, thinking aloud:

- Black screen with white letters. Not like the bank's site. "מקור"? I've never heard of it.
- At the top it says "כל המסלולים בכל החברות". Above that the green button "קרן השתלמות" is already chosen, good.
- The next row has "עוקב מדד S&P 500 12" chosen, in English letters. S, P, five hundred. That's the thing they told me to look for, so I'll go on.
- "12 מסלולים של 12 חברות · דמי ניהול מהחיסכון: מ־0.48% עד 0.7%". So the cheapest is 0.48%. Which company is it?
- "המסלולים מסודרים לפי דמי הניהול מהחיסכון, מהיקר לזול". From the most expensive to the cheapest, so the cheapest is at the bottom. Strange way round.
- First row is מור at 0.7%, so that's the dearest.
- Screen two: אלטשולר שחם 0.66, אנליסט 0.62, אינפיניטי 0.6, הפניקס 0.57, מיטב 0.54, הראל 0.5, מגדל 0.5. Too many numbers. I'm only looking at the column with "ההחיסכון".
- Screen three: מנורה מבטחים 0.49%, then "כלל 0.48% מהחיסכון". That matches the 0.48% at the top.
- Under that is "איילון קופות גמל", which says "עוד לא דווח" with a little orange sign. No number at all, and it's marked "חדש". I won't count that one.
- Grey line at the bottom about "אין": "בסוג הקופה הזה מותר לגבות דמי ניהול רק מהחיסכון". All right.

**What I'd tell my son:**

"I looked it up. The cheapest one that follows that S&P 500 is כלל, at 0.48% a year taken from the savings. מנורה is right behind at 0.49%, and מור is the most expensive at 0.7%. I'm fairly sure, because the line at the top said the range is 0.48% to 0.7%, and כלל was the last line with 0.48%. There's also a new company, איילון, with no fee written at all, so I left it out. The site is called 'מקור', and I'd never heard of it. I'd check the number with the bank or with you before signing anything.

The list is in an odd order, most expensive first, so you have to scroll to the bottom to find the cheapest. The black screen tired my eyes. I didn't understand the column 'חשיפה למניות ולמט"ח' with those coloured rings, or why one company has 101%. I skipped the returns, the 'כסף מנוהל' column and the dotted links. The grey writing at the bottom was small and hard to read."
